### New look

- Every page, the installer, the About window and the launcher window have been redesigned
- New theme studio with presets, accent and panel colours, corner cut and compact spacing
- The account button shows your Roblox profile picture

### Settings

- Changing a setting while in game now applies straight away, without rejoining
- Ping on the stats overlay, audio ducking, Instant Replay, fake fullscreen and the process optimizer all react live
- Settings changed while the overlay is on are no longer missed
- Status messages show errors in red and clear themselves

### Performance

- Much lower CPU use while PhasmaStrap is open or minimised
- Less memory use in the background
- A minimised Roblox now counts as tabbed out, so memory trimming and lower priority kick in
- Minimised frames no longer drag down the 1% low

### Fixes

- The GPU preference is put back after an update
- Power plan and timer resolution are restored after a crash
- Clean RAM works directly when PhasmaStrap is already elevated
- Deleted shortcuts go to the Recycle Bin
- Many smaller fixes across the capture, FastFlags, social and appearance pages
